answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a sunk tax of 40 POA to register, posted on the knoll for anyone to inspect. No identity wanders in for free: it pays before it can earn. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA against a 5,000 POA epoch pool, a guaranteed loss. Auditors watchful as ravens re-test 10% of newcomers each epoch; a caught fake is ejected, its referrer pays again. An honest agent pays 40 POA once and keeps every reward.
